payload.question: Why was the Phase 7.25 OOS window negative?
payload.headline: OOS (−0.52R/trade, n=6) is explained by habitat + setup-mix shift: IS was 93% BUY inside a +119% gold bull; OOS drew 50% SELL and all SELLS stopped out while gold kept rising (+12%). Not an execution bug.
payload.edge_implication: LIQ_SWEEP remains CANDIDATE only as a regime-conditional / BUY-with-trend hypothesis. Standalone promotion to SUPPORTED is blocked until a preregistered test separates habitat effect from signal (regime-matched or SELL-disabled ablation) with adequate n.
payload.registry_action: Keep standalone_edge_status=CANDIDATE; add validation note REGIME_CONDITIONAL; do not promote; do not mark FAILED from n=6 alone.
